title: How is a customer's payment applied to Container Bookings charges?
content:
## Policy clause
Under the Container Bookings product line, a remittance is applied to one booking, written with the remittance reference exactly as quoted by the customer and the amount actually remitted. A payment may not exceed the booking's charges due at the time it is applied; any excess is returned by the finance department and is not booked on the booking. A remittance reference is recorded only once per booking. Prepaid freight is paid by the shipper against the booking before the transport document is released under the transport document rules; collect freight is paid by the consignee at destination and is applied to the same booking. Payments are never allocated across several bookings by the desk; a single remittance covering several bookings is split by the finance department and is outside the desk's handling.

## Worked example (hypothetical amounts)
*Hypothetical figures, for illustration only:*
| Charges due when applied | Amount remitted | Amount booked on the booking | Excess |
|---|---|---|---|
| 800.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | none |
| 800.00 | 1000.00 | 800.00 | 200.00 returned by the finance department |

## Points of judgement
**The same remittance reference is quoted again for the same booking.** It is recorded only once per booking.

**One transfer pays three bookings.** The desk does not split it; the finance department does, outside the desk's handling.

**Who pays collect freight?** The consignee, at destination, and it is applied to the same booking.
